scope: Independent scientific review of 11 changed quiz items and actual current grading of all 12 references; no clinical expert certification or whole-module anatomical coverage approval.

scientific_findings.early_normal_CT: No exclusion, viability or core-size inference; vascular hyperattenuation is framed as a differential.
scientific_findings.ASPECTS: 10 minus 5 arithmetic correct; named regions/modality/side retained; no sole eligibility rule.
scientific_findings.diffusion_CT: Conditional ion-pump and intracellular redistribution explanation; no absolute negative DWI exclusion or fixed tissue evolution milestones.
scientific_findings.WAKE_UP_THAWS: Correctly distinguishes absent visible versus absent marked corresponding FLAIR signal; mismatch does not prove onset, viability or individual eligibility.
scientific_findings.workflow: Explicit local acquisition order; no universal CTA/CTP order or mandatory perfusion for all early cases.
scientific_findings.mismatch: Specified 90/25 = 3.6, 65 mL difference; threshold/software estimates separated from histology and pathway eligibility.
scientific_findings.borderzone: Supports haemodynamic contribution without excluding embolic contributions or prescribing revascularisation/BP.
scientific_findings.CVT: Appropriate venographic assessment before confirmed diagnosis; arterial haemorrhagic transformation and haematocrit alternatives retained.2024 statement supports that haemorrhage due to confirmed CVT does not by itself preclude anticoagulation; no blanket regimen prescribed.
scientific_findings.fogging: Conditional subacute attenuation mechanism and follow-up; no guarantee of resolution, cavity or fixed MRI/enhancement outcome.
scientific_findings.late_window: Urgent eligibility review rather than clock-only denial or mismatch-only benefit claim.
scientific_findings.collaterals: Average association with progression/outcomes, actual phase/extent/coverage, urgent workflow for both patients; no deterministic viability or extra delay.

primary_support.scope: 2026 imaging/reperfusion pathways, large predicted cores and mismatch definitions.
WAKE-UP trial selection, not a deterministic patient tissue clock.
2024 CVT diagnosis and cause-specific haemorrhage/anticoagulation guidance.
Primary 2003 prospective attenuation/fogging study; hypotheses and associations are not universal prognosis.
Primary 2019 case-series fogging appearances and mechanism discussion; not a guarantee of follow-up imaging.
